tests.name: four digits form a postcode
tests.test_code: test("four digits form a postcode", REGULAR_EXPRESSIONS::is_postcode("2530"), true);

tests.name: letters spoil a postcode
tests.test_code: test("letters spoil a postcode", REGULAR_EXPRESSIONS::is_postcode("25a0"), false);

tests.name: five digits are too many
tests.test_code: test("five digits are too many", REGULAR_EXPRESSIONS::is_postcode("25301"), false);

tests.name: sather has a vowel
tests.test_code: test("sather has a vowel", REGULAR_EXPRESSIONS::has_vowel("sather"), true);

tests.name: all capitals is shouting
tests.test_code: test("all capitals is shouting", REGULAR_EXPRESSIONS::is_shouting("HEY"), true);

tests.name: mixed case is not
tests.test_code: test("mixed case is not", REGULAR_EXPRESSIONS::is_shouting("Hey"), false);
